The repo copy is public-static only.

$commentServerOwned: api/ was here until 2026-10-09 and is now repo-owned: sites/memphis-v5/api/ holds the only git copy of the php backend. data/ stays server-side (sqlite + salt) and is still excluded from pulls. sites-sync.sh keeps --exclude api/ so a pull never overwrites the repo copy with the server's, and rsync --delete does not remove excluded paths on the receiving side (measured, not assumed).
